scope: Targeted primary-source verification, not a systematic review or independent replication

cases.title: Experimental Study of the Triplet Synchronization of Coupled Nonidentical Mechanical Metronomes
cases.finding: Coupled nonidentical metronomes exhibit a collective triplet synchronization relation even where individual pairs are asynchronous.
cases.externally_supplied: Metronomes, their energy supply, and mechanical coupling already exist.
cases.scope_limit: Collective coordination need not mean every oscillator has one identical frequency or phase. This does not demonstrate the creation of the oscillators.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher HTML, including experimental description.

cases.title: Controlling the motion of multiple objects on a Chladni plate
cases.finding: Plate vibrations can transport particles; the study uses controlled sequences of excitation to manipulate multiple objects.
cases.externally_supplied: A manufactured plate, particles, actuator, camera and control algorithm are provided.
cases.scope_limit: Distinguish ordinary nodal accumulation from the paper’s actively controlled manipulation. Neither establishes autonomous particle-to-field feedback or reproduction.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher HTML and author-institution abstract. Supplementary videos linked on the paper page were not watched.

cases.title: Independent trapping and manipulation of microparticles using dexterous acoustic tweezers
cases.finding: A phased ultrasonic array independently traps and manipulates microparticles; reported examples include 45 and 90 micrometre spheres.
cases.externally_supplied: An engineered transducer array, liquid medium and pre-existing particles are required.
cases.scope_limit: This particular experiment supports microscale manipulation, not a claim of nanoscale performance or a universal size–frequency law.
cases.read_coverage: Author-institution records and original-paper abstract; not a full methods or data audit.

cases.title: Noise-induced spatial periodicity in excitable chemical media
cases.finding: Numerical excitable-chemical-media dynamics show an intermediate noise regime with enhanced spatial periodicity.
cases.externally_supplied: An Oregonator-type reaction model, diffusion, parameter choices and noisy forcing are specified.
cases.scope_limit: This is a numerical result, not a laboratory observation of the primordial background. Noise acts through existing nonlinear dynamics.
cases.read_coverage: Primary publisher record and abstract; equations and simulation data not independently reproduced.

cases.title: Transition from a uniform state to hexagonal and striped Turing patterns
cases.finding: A chemically supplied reaction–diffusion experiment produces stationary patterned states from a uniform regime.
cases.externally_supplied: Specific reactions, diffusion, gel geometry and reagent supply are provided.
cases.scope_limit: A stationary spatial mode is not automatically a temporal oscillation or a self-maintaining resonator. Uniform-state instability is not identical to noise-induced ordering.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record.

cases.title: Resonant pattern formation in a chemical system
cases.finding: Periodic illumination of a photosensitive chemical oscillator locks responses to the forcing and changes the spatial pattern.
cases.externally_supplied: The reaction medium and periodic optical drive are supplied externally.
cases.scope_limit: The experiment links temporal forcing and spatial organization, not the spontaneous origin of the drive or new fundamental laws.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher abstract and record.

cases.title: Dicke quantum phase transition with a superfluid gas in an optical cavity
cases.finding: A pumped atom–cavity system undergoes a collective transition with mutually coupled matter organization and optical-field dynamics.
cases.externally_supplied: Atoms, cavity boundaries and laser pumping are given.
cases.scope_limit: This is a close geometry–field feedback example, but not unstructured matter producing its own complete apparatus or successive autonomous levels.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher abstract and article record.

cases.title: Tunable colloidal swarmalators with hydrodynamic coupling
cases.finding: Colloidal oscillator phases and spatial organization co-evolve in collective states.
cases.externally_supplied: Feedback-controlled active particles and hydrodynamic interactions are part of the experimental mechanism.
cases.scope_limit: The control architecture is essential context; it cannot be omitted when describing how spontaneous the organization is.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher HTML, including setup/control description.
cases.notes: Published 8 December 2025. The experiment is not a demonstration of an unprogrammed universal source law.

cases.title: Self-Organized Resonance during Search of a Diverse Chemical Space
cases.finding: A driven reacting-particle model develops structures matched to periodic forcing; in the studied regime their energy absorption helps stabilization.
cases.externally_supplied: Toy reaction rules, Brownian dynamics and a periodic drive are specified.
cases.scope_limit: This is not laboratory evidence and does not show that maximum absorption is a universal selection rule. Compare E17.
cases.read_coverage: Original-paper abstract on APS and author-institution record.

cases.title: Experimental observation of self-replicating spots in a reaction–diffusion system
cases.finding: Chemical spots grow and split repeatedly in a laboratory reaction–diffusion system.
cases.externally_supplied: Reactive chemicals and nonequilibrium experimental conditions are supplied.
cases.scope_limit: Pattern duplication is not automatically reproduction with heredity, or a new organizational level. Do not infer a resonant microscopic mechanism merely from the shared shape of the process.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record.

cases.title: Self-Replicating Holes in a Vertically Vibrated Dense Suspension
cases.finding: Holes in a vertically driven starch suspension deform and split under suitable forcing.
cases.externally_supplied: The suspension, container and sustained vertical vibration already exist.
cases.scope_limit: A hole is a spatial pattern in supplied material, not a newly manufactured independent resonator or organism. Shape instability is part of replication here.
cases.read_coverage: Original-paper abstract on APS.

cases.title: Dynamic self-assembly of magnetized, millimetre-sized objects rotating at a liquid–air interface
cases.finding: Magnetically driven objects organize through their motion and fluid-mediated interactions.
cases.externally_supplied: Fabricated magnetic objects, liquid interface and rotating external field are provided.
cases.scope_limit: The result connects maintained activity and spatial arrangement. It does not imply all stable structures need continuous external driving.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record.

cases.title: Spontaneous network formation among cooperative RNA replicators
cases.authors: Vaidya, Manapat, Chen, Xulvi-Brunet, Hayden & Lehman
cases.finding: RNA fragments assemble into catalytic networks; tested cooperative networks have growth advantages over competing autocatalytic cycles.
cases.externally_supplied: Selected RNA sequences, fragments and controlled chemical conditions are supplied.
cases.scope_limit: This supports chemical organizational feedback and cooperation, not an identical acoustic or fundamental-particle mechanism. A formal catalytic graph alone does not establish sustained kinetics.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher abstract and change history; full subscription methods not inspected.
cases.notes: Publisher reports a minor Figure 1 typo corrected on 31 October 2012. No claim here depends on the corrected figure.

cases.title: Transport, Collective Motion, and Brownian Motion
cases.finding: Projection of many-body dynamics leads to a reduced description involving collective variables, memory and effective fluctuating forces.
cases.externally_supplied: Microscopic dynamics and a projection/choice of resolved variables are supplied.
cases.scope_limit: Unresolved dynamics need not be white noise. Describing a system at lower resolution does not physically create a new medium or hierarchy.
cases.read_coverage: Original publisher abstract and record; historical derivation not independently re-proved.

cases.title: Realization of the Hofstadter Hamiltonian with Ultracold Atoms in Optical Lattices
cases.authors: Aidelsburger, Atala, Lohse, Barreiro, Paredes & Bloch
cases.finding: Laser-assisted tunnelling implements an effective lattice Hamiltonian with magnetic-field-like phases.
cases.externally_supplied: Cold atoms, an optical lattice and precisely controlled driving are provided.
cases.scope_limit: This demonstrates selected effective dynamics, not arbitrary alteration of fundamental laws or a frequency-only recipe.
cases.read_coverage: Original-paper abstract on APS.

cases.title: A colloidal viewpoint on the sausage catastrophe and the finite sphere packing problem
cases.finding: Confinement of colloidal spheres in vesicles influences which packing geometries occur, including competing arrangements.
cases.externally_supplied: Pre-existing particles, confining membranes and their material properties are provided.
cases.scope_limit: This is evidence that geometry affects accessible organization, not evidence that every such effect requires resonance.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher HTML; not an independent reproduction of simulations.

cases.title: Drive-specific selection in multistable mechanical networks
cases.evidence_type: simulation; published report also includes experimental evidence
cases.finding: In studied driven mechanical networks, selected configurations absorb relatively little work from the drive.
cases.externally_supplied: Multistable spring networks, their interaction landscape and an external drive are supplied.
cases.scope_limit: This constrains “strongest resonance always dominates”; it does not refute a conditional geometry–mode hypothesis. The experimental portion was not separately method-audited here.
cases.read_coverage: Author preprint arXiv:1908.09332 plus journal metadata and original abstract indexed by PubMed.
cases.notes: The 2019 preprint title is Drive-specific adaptation in disordered mechanical networks of bistable springs. It is not an additional independent study.

cases.title: Optical binding
cases.finding: Illuminated microspheres display light-mediated interactions and bound configurations.
cases.externally_supplied: An external optical field, microspheres and surrounding medium already exist.
cases.scope_limit: Field scattering and particle arrangement interact, but a bound pair is not yet a recursively reproducing hierarchy.
cases.read_coverage: Original-paper abstract and record on APS.

cases.title: Controlling dispersion forces between small particles with artificially created random light fields
cases.finding: Artificially generated random light produces measured attractive interactions between dielectric microspheres.
cases.externally_supplied: Pre-existing spheres and a laser-generated, quasi-monochromatic random optical field are provided.
cases.scope_limit: Random does not mean broadband white noise. The experiment supports fluctuation-mediated interaction, not spontaneous creation of the spheres; broader interaction designs include theoretical proposals.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher HTML, including experimental versus theoretical scope.

cases.title: Self-replicating segregation patterns in horizontally vibrated binary mixture of granules
cases.finding: A shaken granular mixture develops bands that reproduce; segregation and flow/fluidity feedback participate in the dynamics.
cases.externally_supplied: Two grain populations, a container and continued horizontal shaking are supplied.
cases.scope_limit: This connects vibration, organization and pattern multiplication without biological copying machinery. It does not establish successive independent scales.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher HTML. Supplementary materials were not independently reproduced.
cases.notes: Shares an author with E11; these are different systems, not independent replications of a single result.

cases.title: Pattern formation in a Swift-Hohenberg equation with spatially periodic coefficients
cases.finding: A slow-amplitude description is justified for a specified pattern-forming equation near onset, under stated spectral and coefficient assumptions.
cases.externally_supplied: The equation, spatially periodic coefficients and near-instability regime are specified.
cases.scope_limit: A controlled change of scale in description is not an unlimited sequence of new physical levels. The environmental heterogeneity is given, not derived from the emerging pattern.
cases.read_coverage: Publisher HTML, including assumptions and approximation result. Not an independent formal proof check.
cases.notes: 2026 paper available by this audit; September 2026 issue.

cases.title: Thermodynamics of bouncing grains
cases.finding: Grain transport is measured on a heterogeneous, nonresonating vibrating plate; effective statistical and transport descriptions are studied.
cases.externally_supplied: A driven plate, heterogeneity and grains are provided.
cases.scope_limit: Vibration-induced transport is not by itself proof of resonance. The earlier document incorrectly grouped this study as an unqualified resonant-mode example.
cases.read_coverage: Original-paper abstract on APS; no raw-data reanalysis.
cases.notes: APS publication date: 24 August 2026; later index/crawl dates are not used as publication dates.

further_reading.title: Spatiotemporal order out of noise
further_reading.authors: Francesc Sagués, José M. Sancho & Jordi García-Ojalvo
further_reading.note: Corrects incomplete or incorrect authorship in prior notes. Review content is not counted as an additional independent experiment.

further_reading.title: Engineering precise and robust effective Hamiltonians
further_reading.note: The previously cited article exists. Retained as optional reading, not dismissed as fabricated or treated as experimental evidence. Published 2 April 2026.

further_reading.title: Validity of the stochastic Ginzburg-Landau approximation in higher space dimensions: A Wiener algebra approach
further_reading.note: Online publisher record and abstract available at audit. Issue date is 25 October 2026, later than this audit; first-online date was not independently established. Result assumes specific anisotropic periodic domains and regularity of the noise, not arbitrary space-time white noise.
